The **Project Management Professional (PMP)** certification is a globally recognized credential offered by the [Project Management Institute (PMI)](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJQ-xTCEMOHotGHYzwd3zkhh4xKv2bl--dqb4bxucie0kWNzq8svUA_IZfFdUpsKwvMr6m3tJxtNwHUn3xDyt1wcY6e1_u5Kj8lVN3XGk0PQab9d2gi1SGF9xycoyUSnN85-mDqeeDyotmmTqK42-oJc) that validates your skill in leading and managing projects across predictive, agile, and hybrid approaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJQ-xTCEMOHotGHYzwd3zkhh4xKv2bl--dqb4bxucie0kWNzq8svUA_IZfFdUpsKwvMr6m3tJxtNwHUn3xDyt1wcY6e1_u5Kj8lVN3XGk0PQab9d2gi1SGF9xycoyUSnN85-mDqeeDyotmmTqK42-oJc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF18ME_uBts_MLuej29s4lcaLtbnvsjikvFDKLsAoh625BNCXAYlj_eEw-4Mq4XRO47u7Nhz4jtK1T7zh4Lmv74aJ9hyXTdDiE6FurvLVve5RDDvalOWT-wrBG9Ct1ljUYVGcORi9wvl-QLswNKjccAw1GJsV9u7wNUbLyGipLxfB67Kwc40U0FhIkbjVdwEFAEg5yDVlDto9r2FlM-VuabF2ftvlm4Vuk4B_57QWc-46q)

### Eligibility Requirements

- **Four-Year Degree Path:** 36 months of project-leading experience within the past 8 years.
- **High School Diploma / Associate's Degree Path:** 60 months of project-leading experience within the past 8 years.
- **Education Requirement:** 35 hours of project management education, training, or an active CAPM certification.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJQ-xTCEMOHotGHYzwd3zkhh4xKv2bl--dqb4bxucie0kWNzq8svUA_IZfFdUpsKwvMr6m3tJxtNwHUn3xDyt1wcY6e1_u5Kj8lVN3XGk0PQab9d2gi1SGF9xycoyUSnN85-mDqeeDyotmmTqK42-oJc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF18ME_uBts_MLuej29s4lcaLtbnvsjikvFDKLsAoh625BNCXAYlj_eEw-4Mq4XRO47u7Nhz4jtK1T7zh4Lmv74aJ9hyXTdDiE6FurvLVve5RDDvalOWT-wrBG9Ct1ljUYVGcORi9wvl-QLswNKjccAw1GJsV9u7wNUbLyGipLxfB67Kwc40U0FhIkbjVdwEFAEg5yDVlDto9r2FlM-VuabF2ftvlm4Vuk4B_57QWc-46q)

### Exam Details

- **Format:** 180 questions (mixture of multiple-choice, matching, multiple-response, and fill-in-the-blank).
- **Time Limit:** 240 minutes (4 hours) with two 10-minute breaks.
- **Domains:** People (33%), Process (41%), and Business Environment (26%).
- **Delivery:** In-person at Pearson VUE test centers or via online proctoring.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJQ-xTCEMOHotGHYzwd3zkhh4xKv2bl--dqb4bxucie0kWNzq8svUA_IZfFdUpsKwvMr6m3tJxtNwHUn3xDyt1wcY6e1_u5Kj8lVN3XGk0PQab9d2gi1SGF9xycoyUSnN85-mDqeeDyotmmTqK42-oJc)

### Cost

- **PMI Members:** $405 (plus membership and application fees)
- **Non-Members:** $655 (plus application fees)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJQ-xTCEMOHotGHYzwd3zkhh4xKv2bl--dqb4bxucie0kWNzq8svUA_IZfFdUpsKwvMr6m3tJxtNwHUn3xDyt1wcY6e1_u5Kj8lVN3XGk0PQab9d2gi1SGF9xycoyUSnN85-mDqeeDyotmmTqK42-oJc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF15I1af5vWPNbwzIhCgkbc5CEv-ysYKVip8up4exNh-6b0qz36m7M35aqLe3yYvjefQhAGRQVfeFJhqC4YfsAkRryq4Yot4UF6_gYvoGTNyfw0lr_sGnvaOGsRTo2WbRMkkBLedpdKqJkfwb0peofE1wEaLiumWXnexzR-WKM00kvlN16OlGEe2V6LHjIM8P-llqXnQ)

### Maintenance

- The certification is active for a 3-year cycle, during which you must earn **60 Professional Development Units (PDUs)** to renew.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s_zUJ1QOn58)
